headlines.title: 央行：继续实施适度宽松的货币政策
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月2日讯，中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议指出，继续实施适度宽松的货币政策。综合运用逆回购、中期借贷便利、买卖国债等多种货币政策工具，提供短、中、长期流动性，保持流动性充裕，引导金融机构大力支持实体经济有效融资需求。完善短端利率调控机制，增加隔夜逆回购操作品种，收窄临时隔夜正/逆回购操作利率区间。强化利率政策执行和监督，督促金融机构明示贷款综合融资成本，保持社会综合融资成本低位运行。做好市场沟通和预期引导。6月末，社会融资规模同比增长7.4%，广义货币供应量同比增长8.0%。坚持市场在汇率形成中起决定性作用，人民币汇率双向波动。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Continue implementing moderately loose monetary policy
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, Aug 2 – The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. The meeting noted the continued implementation of a moderately loose monetary policy. A combination of monetary policy tools including reverse repos, medium-term lending facilities, and government bond trading will be used to provide short-, medium-, and long-term liquidity, maintain ample liquidity, and guide financial institutions to strongly support effective funding demand in the real economy. The short-end rates mechanism will be improved, with the addition of overnight reverse repo operational tenors and narrowing of the temporary overnight positive/reverse repo rate bands. Strengthened implementation and oversight of rate policy, urging financial institutions to disclose comprehensive lending costs, keep overall social financing costs at a low level, and improve market communication and expectation guidance. At end-June, aggregate social financing grew 7.4% year on year; broad money supply grew 8.0% year on year. The market plays a decisive role in exchange rate formation, with the RMB exchange rate fluctuating in both directions.

headlines.title_zh: 央行将继续实施适度宽松的货币政策
headlines.summary_zh: 中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议，表示将继续实施适度宽松的货币政策。将运用逆回购、中期借贷便利（MLF）和国债买卖等方式向市场投放短期、中期和长期流动性，保持流动性充裕并加以引导。

headlines.title: 央行：继续做好金融支持地方政府融资平台债务风险化解工作 推进融资平台市场化转型
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行8月1日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，稳妥化解重点领域风险。继续做好金融支持地方政府融资平台债务风险化解工作，推进融资平台市场化转型。强化宏观审慎管理和金融稳定保障体系，丰富宏观审慎和金融稳定管理工具箱，校正和阻断金融市场风险的累积，维护金融市场稳定健康发展。发挥好两项支持资本市场货币政策工具的作用。提升存款保险履职效能。稳妥有序推进重点地区和重点机构风险化解。强化打击非法金融活动。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Continue supporting local government financing platform debt risk resolution, advancing market-oriented transformation of financing platforms
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference on Aug 1. The meeting emphasized prudently resolving risks in key areas. Continued financial support for resolving debt risks of local government financing platforms, advancing their market-oriented transformation. Strengthened macroprudential management and the financial stability guarantee system, enriched macroprudential and financial stability management toolkits, corrected and interrupted the accumulation of financial market risks, and maintained sound and stable financial market development. The two monetary policy tools supporting capital markets will be put to good use. Improved the effectiveness of deposit insurance. Prudently and orderly advanced risk resolution in key regions and institutions. Intensified efforts to combat illegal financial activities.

headlines.title: 陈茂波：香港将上调全年经济增长预测
headlines.summary: 香港财政司司长陈茂波8月2日发表司长随笔称，本港今年上半年经济增长为5.1%，较预期强劲。下半年商品出口料继续受惠全球对人工智能产品的强大需求；境外对本港金融及商业服务的需求持续，以及访港旅客的增加，均将带动服务输出增长，有利本地消费和投资气氛。综合考虑整体经济发展情况，本月中发表的经修订全年经济增长预测，将从原先预测的范围向上调整，惟未来走势仍受地缘政治局势发展、美息及其他不确定因素影响。我们将继续保持高度警惕，既大力加快发展经济，也守稳经济金融安全。

headlines.title_en: Chen Maobo: Hong Kong to raise full-year economic growth forecast
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said in his blog on Aug 2 that Hong Kong's economy grew 5.1% in the first half, stronger than expected. In H2, merchandise exports are expected to continue benefiting from strong global demand for AI products; sustained external demand for Hong Kong's financial and business services, along with more visitor arrivals, will drive services export growth, supporting local consumption and investment sentiment. Given overall economic conditions, the revised full-year growth forecast to be released this month will be raised from the original projected range, though the outlook remains subject to geopolitical developments, US interest rates, and other uncertainties. We will remain highly vigilant, vigorously accelerating economic development while safeguarding economic and financial security.

headlines.title: 央行：严厉打击违法违规行为，维护金融市场秩序
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，加快金融市场建设发展。加强制度机制建设，完善金融市场宏观审慎管理指标体系，探索丰富金融市场宏观审慎管理工具箱，健全金融基础设施制度规则和治理体系，加强金融市场运行状况的监测、评估。强化金融市场执法，严厉打击违法违规行为，维护金融市场秩序。稳步推进金融市场高水平开放，优化债券通双向开放机制，有序推进境内外基础设施合作，丰富流动性管理和风险对冲工具。（央行）

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Severely crack down on illegal and non-compliant activities, maintain financial market order
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. The meeting emphasized accelerating financial market development. Institutional mechanisms will be strengthened, macroprudential management indicator systems for financial markets improved, macroprudential management toolkits explored and enriched, financial infrastructure rules and governance systems perfected, and monitoring and evaluation of financial market operations enhanced. Financial market enforcement will be intensified, with severe crackdowns on violations to maintain market order. High-level opening of financial markets will be steadily advanced, the Bond Connect two-way opening mechanism optimized, domestic and overseas infrastructure cooperation promoted in an orderly manner, and liquidity management and risk hedging tools enriched. (PBOC)

headlines.title: 央行：积极稳妥开展央行间货币互换和本币结算合作
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行8月1日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，稳步深化金融改革和对外开放。积极稳妥开展央行间货币互换和本币结算合作。支持和便利更多境外机构参与熊猫债的发行。统筹发展离岸人民币市场，支持上海提升跨境金融、离岸金融服务能力，巩固香港离岸人民币业务枢纽地位。深化跨境贸易和投融资便利化改革。推进人民币跨境支付系统建设，加大跨境支付国际合作力度，完善数字人民币跨境基础设施。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Actively and prudently carry out central bank currency swap and local currency settlement cooperation
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference on Aug 1. The meeting emphasized steadily deepening financial reform and opening up. Active and prudent central bank currency swap and local currency settlement cooperation will be carried out. More overseas institutions will be supported and facilitated to issue panda bonds. Offshore RMB market development will be coordinated, supporting Shanghai in enhancing cross-border and offshore financial service capabilities and consolidating Hong Kong's status as an offshore RMB business hub. Cross-border trade and investment financing facilitation reforms will be deepened. The RMB cross-border payment system will be advanced, cross-border payment international cooperation strengthened, and digital RMB cross-border infrastructure improved.

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Improve quality and efficiency of financial services in key areas and weak links
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, Aug 2 – The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. headlines.title: 央行：金融高水平开放稳步推进

headlines.title_en: PBOC: High-level financial opening-up progresses steadily
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, Aug 2 – The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. The meeting noted steady progress in high-level financial opening. Policies for corporate overseas lending, bank overseas loans, and RMB cross-border interbank financing were optimized. An overseas central bank repo tool was created. High-quality international issuers were facilitated to issue panda bonds in China, with H1 issuance exceeding RMB 160 billion. Positive progress was made in building the RMB cross-border payment system. Support was given to the development of Shanghai and Hong Kong as international financial centers, and to the construction of Xiong'an New Area and the New Western Land-Sea Corridor. Foreign exchange facilitation reforms were deepened, with expanded pilot scope for high-level opening of cross-border trade. Enterprise exchange rate risk management services were improved.

headlines.summary: 中国人民银行8月1日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，加快金融市场建设发展。加强制度机制建设，完善金融市场宏观审慎管理指标体系，探索丰富金融市场宏观审慎管理工具箱，健全金融基础设施制度规则和治理体系，加强金融市场运行状况的监测、评估。强化金融市场执法，严厉打击违法违规行为，维护金融市场秩序。稳步推进金融市场高水平开放，优化债券通双向开放机制，有序推进境内外基础设施合作，丰富流动性管理和风险对冲工具。

headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference on Aug 1. The meeting emphasized accelerating financial market development. Institutional mechanisms will be strengthened, macroprudential management indicator systems for financial markets improved, macroprudential management toolkits explored and enriched, financial infrastructure rules and governance systems perfected, and monitoring and evaluation of financial market operations enhanced. Financial market enforcement will be intensified, with severe crackdowns on violations to maintain market order. High-level opening of financial markets will be steadily advanced, the Bond Connect two-way opening mechanism optimized, domestic and overseas infrastructure cooperation promoted in an orderly manner, and liquidity management and risk hedging tools enriched.

headlines.title: 央行：进一步提升金融管理和服务水平
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行8月1日召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，进一步提升金融管理和服务水平。推动重点立法修法项目。开展金融统计制度与标准框架设计，持续做好重点领域统计监测。提升现金、支付、国库、征信服务质效，进一步优化县域金融服务，强化对金融机构开展县域金融服务的指导和运行情况监测。深化科技管理与创新应用，健全金融业网络安全管理制度。做好第五轮反洗钱国际评估工作。统筹做好安全管理工作，切实做好防汛防灾工作，确保重要信息系统和金融基础设施安全平稳运行。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: Further enhance financial management and service levels
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference on Aug 1. The meeting emphasized further improving financial management and service standards. Key legislative and regulatory revision projects will be advanced. Financial statistics systems and standard framework design will be carried out, with continued statistical monitoring of key areas. Cash, payment, treasury, and credit reporting service quality will be enhanced, county-level financial services further optimized, and guidance and monitoring of financial institutions' county-level services strengthened. Technology management and innovative applications will be deepened, and cybersecurity management systems for the financial industry improved. The fifth round of international anti-money laundering evaluation will be completed. Safety management will be coordinated, with flood and disaster prevention efforts ensured to maintain secure and stable operation of key information systems and financial infrastructure.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_en: [PBOC Holds H2 2026 Work Conference: Continue Implementing Moderately Loose Monetary Policy] On Aug 1, the People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, the meeting thoroughly implemented the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, summarized work since 2026, analyzed the current situation, and deployed work for the next stage. PBOC Party Secretary and Governor Pan Gongsheng attended and delivered a speech. Zhu Hexin, Qu Jishan, Xuan Changneng, Lu Lei, Tao Ling, and Zou Lan attended the meeting.

headlines.title_en: SAFE holds 2026 H2 foreign exchange management work exchange meeting
headlines.summary_en: On Aug 1, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange held its H2 2026 foreign exchange management work exchange meeting via video. The meeting deployed key tasks for H2 2026 foreign exchange management, including steadily expanding institutional opening of the foreign exchange sector. Trade facilitation reforms will be advanced, with a package of measures to optimize current account foreign exchange management, full promotion of high-level cross-border trade foreign exchange receipt and payment facilitation policies, support for new trade formats such as cross-border e-commerce, optimization of service trade foreign exchange settlement, and support for intermediate goods trade development. High-level opening of the capital account will be advanced in an orderly manner, with a package of cross-border investment and financing facilitation policies, nationwide promotion of centralized operation policies for cross-border funds of multinational corporations, introduction of regulations for domestic foreign exchange loans, and steady and prudent expansion of financial market connectivity.
